description:
Mint a revocable API key for the signed-in user, to authorise a script, a CI job or another AI client. The key is a user token with the account's full access: send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` to the Ethora API or the hosted MCP endpoint (or set it in the stdio client). Shown once; store it somewhere safe and do not repeat it in later messages. On an OAuth connection (Claude.ai, ChatGPT) this needs the admin permission and `confirm: true`, the key lives 30 days by default and 90 at most, and it keeps working after the connector is disconnected until it expires or is revoked with `ethora-api-key-revoke`. The user can also create and revoke keys in the dashboard under Account > AI Assistants.
Requires: a signed-in user.
Auth: user mode. Errors: 401 not signed in; 403 `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE` without the admin permission on an OAuth connection; 409 `API_KEY_LIMIT_REACHED` at 20 active keys; 422 `ttlDays` out of range.

confirm.description: Required (`true`) on an OAuth connection: acknowledges that the key value will appear in this conversation and is not limited by this connection's permissions.

name.description: Label to recognise the key later (e.g. `ci-runner`, `import-script`). Defaults to a label naming the client that created it.

ttlDays.description: Lifetime in days. Default 90 (30 on an OAuth connection, where the maximum is 90).

name: ethora-api-key-create
title: Create API Key
